module_title: National Sports Awards - Prize Money, Trophies, and Historic Firsts
introduction: This intermediate tier focuses on the monetary values attached to these prestigious awards, the physical trophies presented to the athletes, and the trailblazing first recipients across specific sports and genders.

core_concepts.title: The 2020 Prize Money Hike
core_concepts.description: In 2020, the Government of India massively increased the prize money for National Sports Awards. The 'Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna' cash prize was raised from ₹7.5 lakh to ₹25 lakh. The 'Arjuna Award' and 'Dronacharya Award (Lifetime)' cash prizes were increased from ₹5 lakh to ₹15 lakh.

core_concepts.title: The Trophies and Statuettes
core_concepts.description: Along with the cash prize, Khel Ratna winners receive a medallion and a certificate. Arjuna Awardees receive a bronze statuette of Arjuna (drawing his bow) and a scroll. Dronacharya Awardees receive a bronze statuette of Guru Dronacharya.

core_concepts.title: First Female Khel Ratna
core_concepts.description: The legendary weightlifter Karnam Malleswari became the first Indian woman to win the Khel Ratna (1994-95). She also holds the record as the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal (Sydney 2000).

core_concepts.title: The Youngest Khel Ratna
core_concepts.description: Abhinav Bindra, India's legendary rifle shooter, won the Khel Ratna in 2001 at the young age of just 18, making him the youngest recipient in the award's history.

important_entities.name: Sachin Tendulkar
important_entities.significance: He became the first cricket player to be honored with the Khel Ratna in the year 1997-98.

important_entities.name: O.M. Nambiar
important_entities.significance: Famous for coaching the legendary athlete P.T. Usha, he was among the first three coaches to receive the inaugural Dronacharya Award in 1985.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Many older textbooks still list the Khel Ratna prize money as ₹7.5 lakh and Arjuna as ₹5 lakh. Do not fall for this trap in statement-based questions. Always use the updated figures: Khel Ratna = ₹25 Lakh, Arjuna = ₹15 Lakh.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Malleswari lifted the heavy weight, Bindra shot early
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: First Woman = Karnam Malleswari (Weightlifting). Youngest = Abhinav Bindra (Shooting).

exam_strategy_tips: Examiners frequently test your knowledge of 'firsts' in popular sports. Always remember Sachin Tendulkar as the first cricketer for the Khel Ratna, followed by MS Dhoni (2007), Virat Kohli (2018), and Rohit Sharma (2020).
